title: The joke that hid Big Smoke's betrayal in GTA San Andreas
subject: bigsmoke
description:
Which Big Smoke line do you still quote? 👇

How GTA San Andreas made its villain the funniest man in the game. Spoilers for GTA San Andreas.

scenes.text: Two number nines, a number nine large, and a lie.
That was the start of Big Smoke's Cluckin' Bell order in the mission Drive-Thru, one of gaming's most quoted lines.
A few missions later, a Vagos train got away and Smoke yelled his other famous line: All we had to do was follow the damn train, CJ!
The game later shows he'd been working with the Ballas and Officer Tenpenny all along.
Those were the same Ballas who killed CJ's mother in a drive-by.
The funniest man in San Andreas was its villain from the start.
